description: Install or uninstall a Distributor package. You can install the latest version, default version, or a version of the package you specify.

action.description: (Required) Specify whether or not to install or uninstall the package.

installationType.description: (Optional) Specify the type of installation. Uninstall and reinstall: The application is taken offline until the reinstallation process completes. In-place update: The application is available while new or updated files are added to the installation.

version.description: (Optional) The version of the package to install or uninstall. If you don't specify a version, the system installs the latest published version by default.

additionalArguments.description: (Optional) The additional parameters to provide to your install, uninstall, or update scripts.
